d: As the United States tightens immigration rules under President Donald Trump, thousands of Indians are turning to temples and shrines to pray for visas and opportunities abroad. In this video, Firstpost visits Telangana’s Chilkur Balaji Temple, popularly known as the ‘Visa Temple’, where devotees perform rituals seeking the chance to study, work or settle overseas. The video examines how tougher H-1B visa rules, a $100,000 fee for certain new applicants and changes to employment-based immigration are adding uncertainty for Indian professionals.
